subject: Trial kickoff — prompt/log transfer & acceptance gates
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Popov <anya@novushealth.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps after demo — trial scope and data we need

Hi Anya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off a limited trial focused on improving triage suggestions in your support console.

High-level scope (what we heard):
- Goal: Reduce time-to-first-action on support tickets by surfacing proposed triage labels and suggested replies.
- Primary dataset: historical support prompts + agent replies (anonymized), and a 5k prompt sample for initial eval.
- Success metric: Mean reduction in agent handle time (TTR) and accuracy of suggested triage label (top-1 label precision >= 78%).

Proposed immediate asks from your side:
1) Share a 1k–5k sample of representative prompts (CSV) for initial model/eval work.
2) A short list of acceptance gates (what counts as pass/fail for the POC).
3) Target timeline — can we aim to have the sample by Friday 12/03?

Logistics we’ll own: staging S3 bucket + secure upload instructions, ingestion template, and an initial eval harness aligned to the acceptance gates. Priyom will own the ingestion schema and Marissa will own success-metric reporting.

Next step: If that timeline works, I’ll send the S3 presigned upload and the ingest template today.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Next steps after demo — trial scope and data we need

Anya — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the sample. I looked through novus_prompt_samples.csv and it’s exactly the sort of variety we need. A few notes and the proposed POC/eval plan attached inline below.

POC: 2-week evaluation (staging) — milestones & owners
- Day 0 (instantiation): Redwood provides S3 presigned bucket + ingestion template (Priyom to own).
- Day 1–3: Novus uploads 2k sample; Redwood runs initial ingest & schema validation. (Owner: Rajiv / Priyom)
- Day 4–7: Redwood configures model variants and baseline ops; run synthetic eval on the 2k sample. (Owner: Aditya / Priyom)
- Day 8–12: Run live inference against a 1% production shadow stream (if Novus approves) and compute acceptance metrics. (Owner: Marissa / Novus eng)
- Day 13–14: Final results review and decision (pass/fail). (Owner: Ben / Novus PM)

Success criteria (proposal):
- Triage label precision (top-1) >= 78% on the eval set OR 10% relative reduction in average TTR vs baseline.
- False-positive triage assignments that route high-risk tickets <= 3% (safety gate).
- End-to-end latency < 400ms median for single-request inference on our staging cluster.

Eval artifacts we’ll deliver:
- Evaluation report (per-customer metrics, confusion matrices)
- Prompt/response pairs used for scoring (anonymized)
- Replayable evaluation harness + seed so you can rerun locally

Data handling options for upload (pick one):
A) Presigned S3 — simplest. We’ll give an account-limited path and clear retention TTL.
B) Transfer via your SFTP — we can pull from a host if you prefer.
C) If logs are considered sensitive, we’ll provide a managed ingestion pod inside your VPC (longer timeline).

Please confirm preferred upload method and whether legal needs an updated MSA/NDA. If Rajiv can upload the 2k sample by EOD 12/03, we’ll start ingestion on Monday 12/06.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Ingest template + sanitization checklist

Rajiv / Anya — attaching a lightweight CSV template and a short checklist for the sanitized log export. Key points:
- Required fields: ticket_id, created_at (ISO8601), user_message, agent_reply, triage_label (if available), metadata.tags
- PII: remove user identifiers and any PHI; replace with stable pseudonyms (e.g., user_0001).
- Max row size: keep examples under 10k tokens; split long conversations into separate rows with parent_ticket_id.
- Compress to gz on upload; we’ll accept gz or parquet.

I’ve attached redwood_prompt_ingest_template.csv — please use it as the canonical schema. If you have questions, ping me on Slack and I’ll jump on a quick call.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
